latest_release.body:
## [5.2.5](https://github.com/margelo/react-native-vision-camera/compare/v5.2.4...v5.2.5) (2026-11-25)

### ✨ Features

* Bump the camera-libs group across 2 directories with 7 updates ([#4241](https://github.com/margelo/react-native-vision-camera/issues/4241)) ([087977a](https://github.com/margelo/react-native-vision-camera/commit/087977a67617667f2104bf9259a0050118125d82))

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* Compile Android resizer shaders on AGP 9 ([#4190](https://github.com/margelo/react-native-vision-camera/issues/4190)) ([e3084ac](https://github.com/margelo/react-native-vision-camera/commit/e3084ac562742fb3cb8c825ef81310e94f830551))
* Regenerate specs with nitrogen 0.37.2 for Kotlin 2.4 ([#4243](https://github.com/margelo/react-native-vision-camera/issues/4243)) ([0de0321](https://github.com/margelo/react-native-vision-camera/commit/0de03210e3e761fc5e10d7263fed64c764ba8668))

hot_issues.title: 🛠️ (iOS) Not possible to build for simulator with react-native-vision-camera-barcode-scanner on iOS 26
🛠️ (iOS) iOS build fails: 'React/RCTMessageThread.h' file not found when building VisionCameraWorklets (when using react-native-vision-camera-worklets)
✨  Allow audio processing similar to frame processing
🐛 [Android] Each FrameOutput leaks its native thread (dispose() doesn't shut down the executor; useFrameOutput never disposes)
🐛 convertCameraPointToFramePoint ignores normalising extents on orientation swap (iOS) — square region maps to a 3.16:1 strip
🐛 CameraOrientation.fromDegrees() has LEFT/RIGHT swapped on Android — doesn't round-trip its own .degrees getter
🐛 [Android] Cannot capture RAW using .capturePhotoToFile() if permission is granted in the same launch of app

detail.readme:
VisionCamera is a powerful, high-performance Camera library for React Native. It features: * 📸 Photo and Video capture * 👁️ QR/Barcode scanner * 📱 Customizable devices and multi-cameras ("fish-eye" zoom) * 🎞️ Customizable resolutions and aspect-ratios (4k/8k images) * ⏱️ Customizable FPS (30..240 FPS) * 🧩 [Frame Processors](https://visioncamera.margelo.com/docs/frame-output) (JS worklets to run facial recognition, AI object detection, realtime video chats, ...) * 🎨 Drawing shapes, text, filters or shaders onto the Camera * 🔍 Smooth zooming (Reanimated) * ⏯️ Fast pause and resume * 🌓 HDR & Night modes * ⚡ Custom C++/GPU accelerated resizer (Metal/Vulkan) Install VisionCamera from npm: ```sh npm i react-native-vision-camera cd ios && pod install ``` ..and get started by [setting up permissions](https://visioncamera.margelo.com/docs)! ### Links - [VisionCamera Documentation](https://visioncamera.margelo.com) - [VisionCamera LLMs.txt](https://visioncamera.margelo.com/llms.txt) - [Community Discord](https://margelo.com/discord) - [Example App](./apps/simple-camera/) - [AWS Device Farm Tests](https://us-west-2.console.aws.amazon.com/devicefarm/home#/mobile/projects/210b1942-012b-4653-9673-f3ff91c5e649/runs) (sign in via the [AWS Access Portal](https://d-9267d6576e.awsapps.com/start) first) ### VisionCamera V4 As VisionCamera V5 is released, VisionCamera V4 is no longer actively maintained. The VisionCamera V4 code has been archived under [margelo/react-native-vision-camera-v4-snapshot](https://github.com/margelo/react-native-vision-camera-v4-snapshot), and the old documentation page is deployed at [visioncamera4.margelo.com](https://visioncamera4.margelo.com). ### ShadowLens To see VisionCamera in action, check out [ShadowLens](https://mrousavy.com/projects/shadowlens)!
### Example ```tsx function App() { return ( ) } ``` > See the [example](./apps/simple-camera/) app ### Adopting at scale VisionCamera is built by [Margelo](https://margelo.com). We make apps better and faster. ### Socials * 🐦 [**Follow me on Twitter**](https://twitter.com/mrousavy) for updates * 📝 [**Check out my blog**](https://mrousavy.com/blog) for examples and experiments * 💬 [**Join the Margelo Community Discord**](https://margelo.com/discord) for chatting about VisionCamera
